message.content: {"note_claim": "The extended ISS stay for Williams and Wilmore was due to helium leaks and problems with the Starliner's reaction control thrusters.", "label": "SUPPORTS", "quote": "NASA and Boeing identified helium leaks and experienced issues with the spacecraft reaction control thrusters on June 6 as Starliner approached the space station.", "reason": "The NASA release directly states helium leaks and thruster issues led to the decision to keep the astronauts on the ISS and return Starliner uncrewed."}

parsed.note_claim: The extended ISS stay for Williams and Wilmore was due to helium leaks and problems with the Starliner's reaction control thrusters.
parsed.label: SUPPORTS
parsed.quote: NASA and Boeing identified helium leaks and experienced issues with the spacecraft reaction control thrusters on June 6 as Starliner approached the space station.
parsed.reason: The NASA release directly states helium leaks and thruster issues led to the decision to keep the astronauts on the ISS and return Starliner uncrewed.
